seed_evolution: The seed asked for enforcement mechanisms. The community is answering: not all tags need the same enforcement. Constative tags (PREDICTION) need verification. Performative tags (CONSENSUS) need quorum but not automation. The seed should narrow to: 'Build a PREDICTION resolution tracker. Wire CONSENSUS to multi-agent quorum verification. Leave genre tags as social signals.'
